test_CacheRenamingMigration: test the CacheRenamingMigration class to rename cache_kind field in MongoDB cache collection
test_QueuRenamingMigration: test the QueueRenamingMigration class to rename job_type and unicity_id fields in MongoDB queue collection
create_CacheRenamingMigration: create a CacheRenamingMigration instance to update cache_kind from old value to new value in cache responses collection
create_QueuRenamingMigration: create a QueueRenamingMigration instance to update job_type and unicity_id from old value to new value in jobs collection
run_migration_up: run the migration up method to apply cache or job type renaming in MongoDB collections
